column1: # Observed ioctl parameter sizes, NVIDIA driver 615.71.09, RTX A2000 (Ampere).
# Captured with nvidia_sniffer under LD_PRELOAD from nvidia-smi, vulkaninfo, a
# CUDA driver-API probe (libcuda via dlopen -- no toolkit installed) and an
# h264_nvenc encode. These are measurements, not a specification.
# This fixture exists to check a claim the 580 fixture alone could not: that
# one table serves a driver 35 releases newer on a different architecture.
# 615.71.09 has no profile of its own and resolves to the 595.71.05 table by
# range selection, so this file is what makes that selection an observation
# rather than an assumption. Every size here is identical to the T4's under
# 580.178.04 -- the frontend ioctl ABI did not move between Turing and Ampere,
